title: GOING FROM PLACE TO PLACE
editorial: We only visited Siem Reap, so we didn’t travel between Cambodian cities. The Phnom Penh–Siem Reap route shown here is an option for a longer itinerary, rather than a journey we took. If Phnom Penh is your port of entry, we’d plan to reach Siem Reap the day before the temple tour. Let your arrival and departure times shape the itinerary: sunrise means an early start.
